items.text: **Closure rebind** (answer 1 in the goal's § *Questions for the user at the goal end*: same class or a subclass, checked at run time, no scope argument; `rule:types/callable-absorbs-closure`, `rule:statements/a-closure-binds-this-only-where-it-uses-it`). Checker: the arm at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:111` reports `E0477` through `report_method_on_erased_receiver` (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:1589`). It needs a `callable`-receiver case for `bind`/`bindTo`(one `?object` argument, same callable type back) and `call`. Layout: a closure is an object whose fields are `[fn#arity, fn#tags, captures...]` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/closure.rs:296`). A captured `$this` is the field named `this` at no fixed slot (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/closure.rs:214`). The literal is built in `lower_closure_literal` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs:2871`). The runtime can find a field by name through `ClassDesc::field_slot`, and can test conformance by name next to `conforms_to` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:1571`). Still open: where the closure class records the class its body was checked against. One option is a `conforms` marker the way `CLOSURE_MARKER` is one (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/mod.rs:4183`). The runtime helper goes beside `nvs_call_closure` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/closure.rs:283`), and `call` lowers through `lower_closure_call` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/call.rs:844`). Delete gap `a-callable-has-no-bind-bindto-or-call` and its question.

**Handle-relative writes under every write door** (answer 2: `Core\Zip::extract` and every `Core\IO` write, with one decision record). The gap is `zip-extraction-creates-a-file-by-path-after-resolving-its-folder` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs:1`.
